about: Juliet A. Davison founded the Boston boutique litigation firm of Davison Law, LLC in 2008 after many years as a partner in a mid-size trial firm in Boston. She focuses her practice at Davison Law on litigation in the following areas: complex business litigation, corporate and partnership disputes, minority shareholder freeze-outs, trust and estate litigation, probate litigation and employment litigation including non-competition and non-solicitation covenants and claims of discrimination, harassment and wage claims. Ms. Davison represents clients throughout New England and the United States and is counsel in a number of cases with clients located overseas in which the application of foreign laws in Massachusetts is at issue. Ms. Davison is recognized for bringing a strategic, practical and results-oriented approach to every engagement.

Ms. Davison graduated from Brown University and the University of California, Berkeley, School of Law. She is admitted to the bar of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, and the State of New York. She is also admitted to practice in the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts, the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 1st Circuit.

Ms. Davison has built a reputation as one of the Northeast's leading litigators. As a result, she has earned numerous honors and awards, including a "Superb" rating from Avvo and an AV-Preeminent peer review rating* from Martindale-Hubbell. Ms. Davison also has extensive experience in mediation and arbitration.

When Ms. Davison is not in the courtroom, she is often found at legal or community events. She is a member of a number of organizations, including the Boston Bar Association, the Massachusetts Bar Association, the Federal Bar Association - MA Chapter, the American Bar Association and the Massachusetts Employment Lawyers Association. She is called on frequently to speak on topics of substantive law and practice development.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
